212. Penalty for interested member voting.—

—   Whosoever votes as member of a 
Panchayat or Zilla Panchayat in contravention of the provisions of sub-section (4) of 
section 55 or clause (g) of sub-section (2) of section 136, shall on conviction, be punished 
with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees.
